purpose: The KMG hard-tech company universe Standard & Works exists to cover every week. Wired into the newsletter writer's STEP 3 so each issue is built COMPANY-first (what our companies did) and not just PUBLICATION-first (what the trade press happened to write). A milestone from one of these companies should not depend on a generic outlet noticing it.

primarySource.name: Relay 'The Wire' feed
primarySource.what: Real-time reindustrialization news firehose. Each item is tagged with company, sectors[], location, source, url, date. Covers ~533 US industrial-base companies across 21 sectors. Pre-filtered to almost exactly our universe, so it is the single highest-signal discovery layer for the issue.
primarySource.howToPull: Load relay.industries/map in Brian's logged-in Chrome (Claude-in-Chrome). The app fetches a news-feed endpoint returning {generatedAt, items:[{headline,date,summary,company,location,sectors,source,url,status}]}. Fetch it from INSIDE the page and read only the fields. The resource URL carries an API key in its query string, so never surface the URL; extract only headline/company/sectors/date/source. Keep only items published after the last sent issue and before staging (Story Freshness Gate).

socialSource.name: Hard Tech Watchlist (X List)
socialSource.what: 133 of our tracked companies + founders on X. Scan recent posts for in-window milestones the trade press has not picked up yet (criticality, first flight, contract award, factory open, first silicon) — companies announce on X before the wires. Verify and quantify against a real source before using.

sectorMap.comment: Relay sector tags -> S&W canonical section. Route each tracked-company item into the matching section's candidate pool.

rules: DISCOVERY, NOT A BYPASS. The Wire + X List surface candidates; every item still has to clear the writer's hard rules — a dollar/output figure, a named source, and an in-window publication date verified against the underlying source URL.
Tracked beats generic. A story about a company in this universe is preferred over a generic trade-press item of equal magnitude. These are the companies we cover.

Scope filter. Relay tags many AI / software / biotech firms that are out of S&W's capex-industrial scope. Route only the hardware / defense / energy / manufacturing / maritime / materials items; let the rest pass to Hardware FYI.
Lead candidates too. The Wire often carries the issue's strongest Lead hook (a cross-company pattern). Feed its items into STEP 4, not just the roundups.
